structure.unit: Medical Care Facilities Certificate of Public Need

law.catch_line: Commencing project without certificate or registration grounds for refusing to issue license
law.text: Commencing any project without a certificate or registration required by this article shall constitute grounds for refusing to issue a license for such project. Persons commencing any project without a certificate or registration as required by this article shall be subject to the penalties set forth in §§ 32.1-27 and 32.1-27.1.
